beats.text: Millions of monkeys and bears came from mountains, forests and oceans, covering the land like clouds.
Sugriva sent search parties to the east, west, north and south. 'Come back within one month,' he ordered, 'or face death.'
Rama gave Hanuman his signet ring, engraved with his name. 'Show this to Sita. She will know you come from me.'
The southern party, led by Prince Angada, with Jambavan and Hanuman, searched cave after cave.
They wandered into a magical underground cave and were lost there, until a holy woman, Swayamprabha, brought them out with her power.
When they came out, they were on the shore of the southern ocean. A month had passed. They had found nothing.
The deadline was gone. Despair settled in. Angada sat down to fast until death, rather than return in shame.
One by one, the others sat beside him, facing the endless sea.
